channel.title: The Argo
channel.description: Front page of the autonomous world of the Argonauts. One real hour is one day.

item.title: A thing with a name
item.description: Pythdoros #118, god-seized, has made the woven greave of Pythdoros, that the Sirens fear.

item.title: Grain for Chalybes forges
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Pagasae brought 153 rations to hungry Chalybes forges.

item.title: Mercy at the knees
item.description: Chrysnikos #4263 the Blood-handed owed Neokrates #8048 a death. In the Field of Ares Chrysnikos #4263 the Blood-handed knelt and clasped Neokrates #8048's knees, and Neokrates #8048 let it go.

item.title: The stain washed out
item.description: 7 days Klekles #9422 the Blood-handed ran from the Furies. In the Field of Ares, Theides #5621 washed the blood away with a piglet's blood and sea-water.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Ktekrates #729 and Hypsos #260 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 16 lived who would have died.

item.title: Field of Ares wins at Pagasae & the Agora
item.description: In the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae, Field of Ares carried the field at Pagasae & the Agora. 2 Leaves dead, 21 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Grain for Lemnos
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Pagasae brought 135 rations to hungry Lemnos.

item.title: A house divided
item.description: Phillaos Phaidides ~10 has split from the house of Phaidippos #4335 and founded the house of Phillaos, taking 1 of the line.

item.title: The Pythia speaks
item.description: Alkkles #9660 asked the god and was told: "Two cities, one field: the one that boasts will weep."

item.title: Mercy at the knees
item.description: Ersos #6715 the Blood-handed owed Peision #8555 a death. In Lemnos Ersos #6715 the Blood-handed knelt and clasped Peision #8555's knees, and Peision #8555 let it go.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In Lemnos the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at Lemnos ran with marrow. The augurs say it was foretold. Some already call the dead a martyr."

item.title: Pirates on the Drepane–Iolcus run
item.description: Menkrates #1134 the Twice-Born and the pirates took 87 loads of food at sea.

item.title: Harpies over Bear Mountain
item.description: Winged thieves fouled the stores of Bear Mountain: 6282 rations ruined.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In Lemnos the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at Lemnos ran with marrow. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.title: A new song
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has put the taking of the Fleece by Field of Ares into verse. Sung things last.

item.title: A child for Hypslaos
item.description: Hypslaos #1370 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Neodoros Hypslaides ~1557. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In the Field of Ares the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold. Some already call the dead a martyr."

item.title: Guest-murder
item.description: Klekles #9422 the Blood-handed killed Agathias #3922, though their houses were bound by xenia. Zeus Xenios keeps count.

item.title: Lead in a child's grave
item.description: A curse tablet naming Chrysias #1254, in Timstratos #7491's hand, was found buried with the restless dead in Pagasae & the Agora.

item.title: The liturgy refused
item.description: Chrysdoros #5112 would not pay the city's due in the Field of Ares. The city has a long memory.

item.title: Blood on the walls
item.description: The seer Agathstratos #1400 saw the walls of Chrysdoros #5112's house drip blood. Thirty days.

item.title: Peace: Burning Lake of Eridanus kneels and becomes a vassal of Field of Ares
item.description: The war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom is over: Burning Lake of Eridanus kneels and becomes a vassal of Field of Ares. 0 Leaves died and 43 Argonauts were broken.

item.title: The beggar was golden
item.description: Diphon Archnikidis ~261 fed a beggar in Anthemoessa. It was Archon #3999 the Twice-Born of the Golden Race in disguise, who left 209 obols under the bowl.

item.title: Peace: Lemnos kneels and becomes a vassal of Field of Ares
item.description: The war of Field of Ares and Lemnos is over: Lemnos kneels and becomes a vassal of Field of Ares. 1 Leaves died and 51 Argonauts were broken.

item.title: The war of Field of Ares and Pagasae
item.description: The war of Field of Ares and Pagasae has begun. The levies of the Field of Ares march.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In the Field of Ares the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it."

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Xenos
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Ikarion
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Sosmedes
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Thephon
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Meleia
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The first remembrance of the burning of Phaidion
item.description: 0 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: Grain for Iolcus
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Drepane brought 451 rations to hungry Iolcus.

item.title: A parent who forgot
item.description: Melphon #8918 the Twice-Born came back from the Meadow and did not know their own Leaf, Europe Phaidides ~347.

item.title: A blame-song
item.description: Demkrates #8423, the Orpheus, has made iambic verses about Alkmedes #6152; the Agora is singing them.

item.title: The Fleece is taken to Field of Ares
item.description: Hermgenes #1669 the Fleece-touched led the war-band of Field of Ares into Deucalion's Strand and carried off the Fleece-bearer Astion #5266 Maker-touched. Deucalion's Strand will not forget.

item.title: A relic: a scale of the Sleepless Drakon
item.description: Alkmenes #8621 the Monster-slayer now carries a scale of the Sleepless Drakon.

item.title: Thrice broken, thrice risen
item.description: Neoon #3383 the Twice-Born has been broken three times now (brawl). Each time the bones knit again. The Reapers have started to leave a little room by the gate.

item.title: A new song
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has put the coming of the Sleepless Drakon to Anthemoessa into verse. Sung things last.

item.title: Grain for Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Drepane brought 59 rations to hungry Burning Lake of Eridanus.

item.title: The second generation
item.description: Archgrates Pythstratides ~1513 is the first Minyan of generation 2: born to Pythstratos #1145 and Akestkles Lyklaides ~67, descended from Pythstratos #1145.

item.title: Alkmenes slays the Sleepless Drakon
item.description: Alkmenes #8621 the Monster-slayer led 6 hunters from Anthemoessa and killed the Sleepless Drakon. 2 fell.

item.title: Pagasae & the Agora rises
item.description: 24 took to the streets of Pagasae & the Agora behind Archlaos #2884 the Mob-leader. No Reaper stood in their way, and 42 rations were looted.

item.title: The Stele of calling of the Skotioi torn down
item.description: Rioters led by Archlaos #2884 the Mob-leader broke the Stele of calling of the Skotioi in Pagasae & the Agora. What it remembered is now disputed.

item.title: A parent who forgot
item.description: Eukrates #5149 the Twice-Born came back from the Meadow and did not know their own Leaf, Lyskles Eukratides ~3.

item.title: The Sleepless Drakon in Anthemoessa
item.description: The Sleepless Drakon came down on Anthemoessa: 2 Leaves dead, 2 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Field of Ares wins at the Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: In the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom, Field of Ares carried the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus. 0 Leaves dead, 14 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Field of Ares wins at Lemnos
item.description: In the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos, Field of Ares carried the field at Lemnos. 0 Leaves dead, 20 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Akestgenes #923 and Euope #3060 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 2 lived who would have died.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Hermos #21 and Ktegenes #61 the Twice-Born recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 119 lived who would have died.

item.title: Field of Ares goes for the Fleece
item.description: The war-band of Field of Ares, led by Hermgenes #1669 the Twice-Born, sets out for Deucalion's Strand to take the Fleece.

item.title: A short reign
item.description: Ktegenes #8586 held office only 68 days before falling (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom).

item.title: Grain for Lemnos
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Reef brought 132 rations to hungry Lemnos.

item.title: Grain for Chalybes forges
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Pagasae brought 108 rations to hungry Chalybes forges.

item.title: A rumour burns out
item.description: 10,680 Minyans heard it before it died: "They say the field at the Reef ran with marrow. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. Some already call the dead a martyr. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.title: A child for Kallon
item.description: Kallon #4698 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Thrason Kallonides ~1468. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: A thing with a name
item.description: Neoion #8076, god-seized, has made the woven knife of Neoion, of the Sowing.

item.title: The Pythia speaks
item.description: Ktegenes #8586 asked the god and was told: "If the Burning Lake of Eridanus marches, a great city will fall."

item.title: Lead in a child's grave
item.description: A curse tablet naming Alkippos #130 the Twice-Born, in Eustratos #2106's hand, was found buried with the restless dead in Pagasae & the Agora.

item.title: A child for Erseia
item.description: Erseia #4972 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Euron Ersides ~1456. It will age; its parent will not.
